propositions: The code-review gate declares a model CLASS on all five LLM-calling steps, but these declarations are silently ignored at runtime; every call runs on the single resolved cfg.model instead
PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config.model and resolves the model only from the config the runner was constructed with (self._config), ignoring per-step model overrides
The usage log records op (prompt name) but not step id, making it impossible to attribute calls to steps when a single prompt is used by multiple steps
Step 0 (observability) requires threading step id and raw declared model class token through a ContextVar so usage_log.record() can write per-step attribution
An offline end-to-end test with a discriminating class table must observe RED before the fix and GREEN after, proving each of five code-review steps receives its declared model, not cfg.model
